fact: At the July 2025 WHO workshop Benin reported a DHIS2-based NTD data repository integrating NTD data and medicine stock management with the national e-SIGL, with interoperability with ESPEN and Alafiacomm not yet effective.
title: Integrated Workshop on Data Collection, Reporting, and Utilization for Preventive Chemotherapy NTDs - Day 1
publisher: WHO Regional Office for Africa / ESPEN
